context.transcript:
This is Christine Li with the business news. In July,
Tasty Treats, an Australian candy manufacturer, officially
purchased Hilltorn Enterprises. Hilltorn sells a wide variety of
healthy snacks. Since sales of sugary products are declining
worldwide,
Tasty Treats hopes to diversify its products by
expanding into this rapidly growing market. Look for their
rebranded packaging on store shelves near you.
packages carry a new logo that features the initials of both
context.transcript_translation: 这里是Christine Li带来的商业新闻。今年七月，澳大利亚糖果制造商Tasty Treats正式收购了Hilltorn Enterprises。Hilltorn销售各种健康的零食。由于全球范围内含糖产品的销量正在下降，Tasty Treats希望通过进军这个快速增长的市场来使产品多样化。请留意您附近商店货架上重新包装的包装。这些包装带有两个公司首字母组成的全新标志。
